items.text: You were told by a jogger who crosses the bridge every day, who is right about matters like this 3 times out of 4, that the inspectors found the Tarn Lane footbridge too weak.

You checked the council's bridge inspection report yourself, which is right about matters like this 49 times out of 50. It shows that the Tarn Lane footbridge passed its weight-limit test without any problems.
